row.title: Unlearn change layer: graded practices with private trials
row.body: Rowan asked for evidence-based change, not only debunking. Practices are full graded entries with a trial kit; all personal trial data stays in the reader's browser; the server counts anonymous events per practice and re-orders suggested if-then plans by keep rate; oversold claims (power posing, ego depletion, growth mindset) get no kit; the Lab drafts candidate practices from intervention reviews under the same grounding guards.

title: Unlearn change layer: graded practices with private trials
